نتباين (form VI)
# نَتَبَايَنُ (natabāyanu) /na.ta.baː.ja.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَايَنَ (tabāyana)
# نَتَبَايَنَ (natabāyana) /na.ta.baː.ja.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَايَنَ (tabāyana)
# نَتَبَايَنْ (natabāyan) /na.ta.baː.jan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَايَنَ (tabāyana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
